newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STYL SUSPENDED AFTER PRICE FALL.
newsitem.headline: STYL SUSPENDED AFTER PRICE FALL.

text.p: Trading was suspended in Hungarian clothing manufacturer Styl Ruhagyar Rt on Wednesday following one single deal for its stocks, one trader said.
The suspension came at 1038 GMT as the price of 875 forints was unacceptably below that at Tuesday's close of 1,300.
The deal was concluded for 13,500 stocks and the dealer said this item may have included the 13,000 stocks for which Styl lodged a buyback order on Tuesday.
In a statement, published in the official bourse gazette this morning, Styl said that the order for the 13,000 stocks to be met at market price, was lodged on December 17.
This was Styl's second order to buy own shares in the past week, as the company lodged a similar order for 10,000 shares on December 11.
